name: Persinger lab: right temporoparietal burst-firing (20 min)
origin: Laurentian University: Richards, Koren & Persinger 1992; Healey, Persinger & Koren 1996; Persinger & Healey 2002
summary: Burst-firing over the right temporoparietal region only, 1 uT for 20 min. With right-sided fields Persinger's lab reported a marked rise in hypnotic suggestibility (Healey 1996), apprehension in women (Richards 1992) and, with an unnamed 'complex, pulsed' pattern, more sensed presences, fears and odd smells than with left-sided or sham fields (Persinger & Healey 2002).
notes: Healey, Persinger & Koren 1996 gave 20 min of 1-uT burst-firing over the right hemisphere, the left, both or a sham, with Spiegel's Hypnotic Induction Profile before and after, and reported a marked rise in suggestibility only in the right group (eta = 0.58); Richards 1992 reported apprehension in women with right- but not left-sided bursts. Persinger & Healey 2002 (48 people) ran the same four arms at 100 nT-1 uT with fields 'primarily over' one side; they name no pattern ('complex, pulsed'), so burst-firing there is an assumption, and any field they had on the other side is off here. The presence-right program plays the same burst timing on four right-side coils and adds an optional 10 min; this file keeps the 20-min, two-coil form. The lab's burst-firing point values were never published; the built-in accelerating burst (6 to 30 Hz) stands in, with the file's published length, 230 points of 3 ms (0.69 s; Carniello 2020; other theses give 248 or 289), once every 4 s (the lab's rat analgesia work, Martin & Persinger 2004, and Collins 2014's Shiva study; Persinger, Hoang & Baker-Price 2009 give 'once every 3 s for about 0.7 s'). Two coils, T8 and TP8, are an inference from 'right temporoparietal'; the left channels stay silent. Tiller & Persinger 1994 (15 min of a 1-uT 'pulsed' field) reported higher suggestibility only when the right side came first (persinger-tiller-1994-right-then-left), so log the order in any comparison; and a field that raises suggestibility confounds every unblinded session, so compare blind (right, left, persinger-burst-temporal-bilateral, sham). The suggestibility effect has not been replicated outside the lab (the lab's re-analysis of 19 of its own experiments, St-Pierre & Persinger 2006, is not independent evidence). Independent double-blind tests found no field effect (Granqvist 2005; Gendle & McGrath 2012), and in Granqvist's study suggestibility traits, not the field, predicted the reports. Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history, implanted devices or pregnancy; stop at once on fear, headache or distress.
setting: Partial sensory deprivation: blindfold or opaque goggles, reclining in a very quiet, darkened room. For the suggestibility test, take a standard hypnotic-susceptibility scale before and after (the lab used Spiegel's Hypnotic Induction Profile), scored by someone who does not know the condition.
schedule: One 20-min exposure per arm. At most once a week; run right, left, bilateral and sham sessions in blinded, counterbalanced order.
source: Healey, Persinger & Koren 1996, Int J Neurosci 87:201 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/9003980/ ; Richards, Koren & Persinger 1992, Percept Mot Skills 75:667 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/1408634/ ; Persinger & Healey 2002, J Nerv Ment Dis 190:533 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/12193838/ ; Tiller & Persinger 1994, Int J Neurosci 79:157 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/7744557/ ; St-Pierre & Persinger 2006, Int J Neurosci 116:1079 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/16861170/ ; Carniello 2020, PhD thesis, Laurentian University, p. 89 (230-point burst-firing file, 3-ms points) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/8c92763c-cd19-4a21-b242-3b572a28ce55 ; Collins 2014, MA thesis 'Investigating the Shiva', Laurentian University, p. 31 (289 points, 3 ms, 4000 ms) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/items/16d96136-680c-4afe-8044-f9137bd01afc ; Martin & Persinger 2004, Neurosci Lett 366:226 (burst-firing once every 4 s) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15276252/ ; Persinger, Hoang & Baker-Price 2009, Electromagn Biol Med 28:374 ('once every 3 s for about 0.7 s') https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20017628/ ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
